scope: AllPerson+allKnows; complete authored messages for IS2 persons and IC2 friends; complete ReplyOf ancestor paths; IS1 location relations; endpoint and owner-root closure

steps.name: parameters
steps.sql: CREATE TEMP TABLE seed_people(id uuid, role text)

steps.name: all_person
steps.sql: CREATE TEMP TABLE selected_ids(id uuid PRIMARY KEY)

steps.name: persons
steps.sql: INSERT INTO selected_ids SELECT id FROM anchors WHERE kind='NodeAnchor' AND arch_type='Person'

steps.name: all_knows
steps.sql: INSERT INTO selected_ids SELECT id FROM anchors WHERE kind='EdgeAnchor' AND arch_type='Knows' ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

steps.name: authors
steps.sql: CREATE TEMP TABLE authors AS SELECT id FROM seed_people WHERE role='is2' UNION SELECT CASE WHEN e.src=p.id THEN e.dst ELSE e.src END FROM seed_people p JOIN anchors e ON e.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND e.arch_type='Knows' AND(e.src=p.id OR e.dst=p.id) WHERE p.role='ic2'

steps.name: messages
steps.sql: CREATE TEMP TABLE messages AS SELECT DISTINCT e.src AS id FROM authors a JOIN anchors e ON e.dst=a.id AND e.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND e.arch_type='HasCreator' JOIN anchors m ON m.id=e.src AND m.kind='NodeAnchor' AND m.arch_type IN('Post','Comment')

steps.name: reply_chain
steps.sql: CREATE TEMP TABLE reply_nodes AS WITH RECURSIVE chain(id) AS(SELECT id FROM messages UNION SELECT e.dst FROM chain c JOIN anchors e ON e.src=c.id AND e.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND e.arch_type='ReplyOf') SELECT id FROM chain

steps.name: reply_nodes_insert
steps.sql: INSERT INTO selected_ids SELECT id FROM reply_nodes ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

steps.name: reply_edges
steps.sql: INSERT INTO selected_ids SELECT e.id FROM reply_nodes n JOIN anchors e ON e.src=n.id AND e.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND e.arch_type IN('HasCreator','ReplyOf') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

steps.name: locations
steps.sql: INSERT INTO selected_ids SELECT e.id FROM seed_people p JOIN anchors e ON e.src=p.id AND e.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND e.arch_type='IsLocatedIn' ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

steps.name: endpoints
steps.sql: INSERT INTO selected_ids SELECT a.src FROM anchors a JOIN selected_ids s ON s.id=a.id WHERE a.src IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT a.dst FROM anchors a JOIN selected_ids s ON s.id=a.id WHERE a.dst IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
